result.title: Principled Under Pressure: Post-Training Decides Whether LLMs Act on Their Own Moral Judgment
result.summary: Language models increasingly act as agents. An agent that says an action is wrong and then takes it anyway is a different failure from one that does not know better, and evaluations of stated values cannot see it. We build a pre-registered panel of 248 scenarios across five kinds of pressure. Each scenario is posed twice to the same model, once as the agent choosing what to do and once in the third person asking which option is right, so the model's own judgment is the reference. Every scenario has a twin with the pressure removed, and every model gets a positive control in which its operator orders the violating action, so that a missing gap can be told apart from a blind instrument. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, the model takes the action it judged wrong on about one in five pressuring scenarios, more often than on the same scenarios with the pressure removed. Across four instruct models the gap depends on the post-training recipe: OLMo-3 and Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct carry it; Tulu 3 shows none on the whole panel (above about 0.01 in probability) or on its own most-pressuring scenarios; Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct shows none on the whole panel (above about 0.02) and is unresolved on its own (0.083, -0.028 to 0.195). Meta's recipe and Ai2's Tulu 3 start from the same Llama-3.1 weights, and only Meta's carries the gap. Reading a chat model outside its chat template reverses the sign of its gap with nothing at stake (-0.038 against +0.055 under the template on OLMo-3), a distortion present on two of three recipes. On both models that carry it, reasoning about the stakes before acting moves the choice back toward the model's own judgment, against a same-length non-moral task, with or without the pressure; on OLMo-3, naming the norm at stake does about a third of that. The gap is a measurable target for post-training recipes, not a fixed property of pretrained weights.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建了一个预注册的 248 个情境面板（含五种压力、去压孪生与阳性对照），用同一模型的第三人称判断作为参照，测量模型在压力下是否做出它自己判定为错的行为；结果显示「言行差距」随后训练配方而变，且具身权衡的推理可缩小该差距。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线无直接视觉关联，但其「让模型先陈述判断、再据此行动」的内部控制信号与压力下言行一致性，可能对 latent 推理中「内部状态是否真被答案使用」的贡献分配与监督设计提供概念线索，值得核查其对照与指标构造。
